brief: iOS 建置或測試要排隊等別人先用完時整段靜默數分鐘，等的人分不出是在排隊還是已經卡死。
detail: All four handwritten iOS shlock waits (ios_test build/device, ios_build, ios_release) emit only entry/acquired/timeout; a live ios_ops test waited over two minutes with no progress after the first line. This violates the repository's <=20s visible-progress contract and makes an alive queued process indistinguishable from a hang, encouraging agents to bypass or kill typed iOS tooling.
plan: Use ops/lib/ios_lock_wait.sh as the common shlock acquisition primitive. Emit 15-second phase=lock-wait heartbeats with waiter/holder liveness; preserve stale-steal and each caller original timeout boundary. Fixture four caller kinds with fake shlock/sleep and assert only 15s/30s emissions through 33s, acquire-stop, dead/invalid holder.
resolution:
已修（4a2f4ed53）：`ops/lib/ios_lock_wait.sh` 成為四支 iOS 腳本共用的 shlock 取得原語，`kg_ios_wait_for_shlock` 在等待期間每跨過一個 heartbeat 邊界就印一行 `phase=lock-wait kind=… elapsed=…s pid=… alive=true holderPid=… holderAlive=…`，其中 holderAlive 由 `kill -0` 觀測。呼叫者：`ios_build.sh:182`、`ios_test.sh:711`（build 鎖）、`ios_test.sh:781`（device 鎖）、`ios_release.sh`。

本條在 2026-08-08 的收斂盤點中被認定為殭屍票（修法已落地、狀態仍為 triaged）。結案由 acceptance gate 實跑其 acceptance_cmd 確認，不是憑 plan 文字。
scope: 把四支 iOS 腳本各自手寫的等待段收斂成一份共用實作，另加一組模擬等待情境的測試。
source: andon:/root/ios_lock_heartbeat; live review-card-layout-editor ios_ops test lock wait
verified_evidence: 結案閘實跑 bash ops/test_ios_ops.sh rc=0（73.9s）；另以磁碟讀取確認 ops/lib/ios_lock_wait.sh 存在且四個呼叫點（ios_build.sh:182、ios_test.sh:711/781、ios_release.sh）全部改用它，heartbeat 行帶 holderPid/holderAlive
